title: Choose the entry composition
question: The roll assigned Carbon-copy desk. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Visual world stays the racing form; this pick is structure only.

options.label: Carbon-copy desk
options.lineage: Racing-secretary nomination desk: original sheet and carbon
options.thesis: You fill the original; a carbon horse-card prints beside it as you write.
options.viewport: Masthead, then two equal sheets: left numbered entry papers (name, market, strategy, bot wallet same/other, opening purse) with the stamp at the foot; right a hot-sheet carbon of the horse as it will print on the card.
options.risk: Twin sheets read as a gimmick if the carbon is not a true racing-form call.

raised.raise: This page is the author face of the same racing card the landing browses.
Stamping does not change routes; the filled original gathers into the receipt on this sheet.

options.label: Condition-book spread
options.lineage: Overnight condition book: facts on the left, nomination on the right
options.thesis: A two-page sheet: left says what entering is; right is the papers.
options.viewport: Masthead spans a spread. Left: three agate facts plus a miniature racing-card sample. Right: name, silks, strategy, wallet, opening purse, stamp.
options.risk: A visitor coming from the card gets a lesson they already had; the left page can stall the clerk.

options.label: Clerk window
options.thesis: One teller slip. Fill it, stamp it, go see the horse.
options.viewport: Masthead, then a single full-width slip: 01–05 lines for name, market, strategy, wallet, purse; stamp at the foot; no preview column.
options.risk: A visitor who never opened the racing card never sees what a horse looks like until they leave.
